items.name: NEW YEAR'S DAY 2025 NATIONAL BANK CLOSURE
items.notes: Strong date match: New Year's Day bank closure supports reduced CBD banking and professional-services activity in the normal morning window; medium explanatory value because it is sector-specific, not a direct CBD footfall measure.

items.name: MEL NYE 2024 FREE PUBLIC TRANSPORT ENDS AT 6AM
items.notes: Strong boundary match: special NYE free transport ends at 06:00, so 06:00-10:00 is post-dispersal rather than active event movement; supports below-baseline when combined with public holiday suppression.

items.name: VICTORIA NEW YEAR'S DAY PUBLIC HOLIDAY 2025
items.notes: Strong date match: New Year's Day public holiday applies all day; state-wide scope supports reduced normal Wednesday CBD commuter/business demand; strong support for below-baseline morning activity after NYE dispersal.

items.name: AUSTRALIA PUBLIC HOLIDAY OFFICE AND SHOP CLOSURE PATTERN
items.notes: Conceptual match: public holidays commonly reduce office, banking and some retail activity; this supports lower weekday-morning CBD demand during 06:00-10:00, but it is not a direct pedestrian count.

items.name: QUEEN VICTORIA MARKET NEW YEAR'S DAY PUBLIC HOLIDAY CLOSURE
items.notes: Local match: QVM closure supports reduced activity near the QVM sensor area; low explanatory value for the full network-wide candidate because the effect is site-specific rather than CBD-wide.

items.name: VICTORIA SUMMER SCHOOL HOLIDAY ON NEW YEAR'S DAY 2025
items.notes: Supporting calendar match: 1 January falls within the Victorian summer school holiday period; supports reduced school-related morning movement, but this is secondary evidence rather than a standalone CBD footfall explanation.
